create.title: Aggregate positive-line alpha localization of the endpoint-free beta vector
create.statement_tex: At fixed finite U,V,S and from the common fixed-w endpoint-free beta vector, first sum the complete sixteen product Cauchy--Green cells to the original positive-a, positive-b representative R_u R_v[psi(beta)Q_ef]. Only then apply 1=chi_0(alpha)+(1-chi_0(alpha)). Prove that the central terminal is exactly the three-selector functional with j=0 singular u^(-1) under signed Plemelj, j=0 regular top, and j>=1 interior profiles under ordinary mu integration; split the oriented artificial-pole coefficient under the same alpha partition; and identify the direct positive-line complement exactly with the accepted large-alpha package. Retain all D_j,H_j floors, stars, chi_4, equality and collision conventions, separately routed modules, and the external -(4/pi)X^(1/4)Re(e(1/8) dot) factor once. No individual transferred row is assigned a physical limit.
create.next_action: Prove the exact central/complement split of the oriented artificial residue, match the positive-line complement to the accepted large-alpha theorem, and obtain a mathematically isolated rederivation of the complete positive-line certificate.

update.statement_tex: For the exact beta-owned compact positive-line terminal obtained only after complete finite Stokes recombination, with Theta_db=psi(beta)chi_0(alpha) on 0<=a, a+b<1/2, and a/2+b<1/4, prove sup_x(|A(x)|+x|A'(x)|)=O_epsilon(X^epsilon). The analytic compact estimate is already proved for the corrected three selector classes: j=0 singular top under signed Plemelj, j=0 regular top, and j>=1 interior profiles under ordinary integration. Promotion now requires the aggregate positive-line alpha-localization certificate, including the artificial-pole share and exact match to the accepted large-alpha complement, plus a mathematically isolated proof of this corrected functional. No rowwise sixteen-stratum amplitude equality is required or lawful.
update.next_action: Validate the aggregate positive-line localization, oriented artificial residue, and large-alpha complement match; then run a clean mathematical statement-only proof of the corrected compact amplitude estimate.

Close the aggregate positive-line alpha-localization certificate and double-bounded estimate, then compose with the proved large-alpha beta package. The alpha-bounded zeta-high branch remains separate.
Use aggregate-before-localization rather than rowwise transfer. Validate the positive-line compact/artificial split and corrected compact estimate; the large-alpha symbol remains closed.

reject.reason: The sixteen terms are finite product-Stokes representation cells, not ownership projectors or separately limiting physical amplitudes. Accepted height limits occur after their complete finite sum is returned to the original positive-line operator. The mixed psi''/4 cell is indispensable in that sum but has no independent compact-amplitude type.

A label such as L_uL_v, B_uP_v, or A_uA_v specifies contour geometry only. Terminal, radial-side, or module ownership depends on the common antecedent, and no individual beta-masked row inherits the aggregate physical-module theorem.

Transferring psi(beta)chi_0(alpha) differentiates both cutoffs. Central and complementary alpha shares cancel chi_0 derivatives only after recombination; the beta psi''/4 mixed cell survives until the whole Stokes complex is returned to the positive line.

The endpoint-free vector is T[R1]+P_rho[R1] after radial-side removal. The oriented artificial coefficient is separately owned and must be localized and estimated under the same alpha partition; inserting it into the terminal functional would double count or conceal a distinct contour stratum.

The statement-only report correctly proves the frozen rowwise packet underdetermined, but it was exposed to injected repository instructions and did not contain the positive-line replacement theorem. It cannot validate that replacement.

no_change.reason: Its analytic large-alpha estimate remains accepted; only the exact match to the newly corrected positive-line complementary representation needs a separate certificate.
The corrected positive-line compact certificate, double-bounded beta cell, alpha-bounded branch, and other M1 interfaces remain open.
No unconditional Gauss-circle estimate is claimed.

round_assessment.reason: Round 44 rigorously rejects a type-wrong rowwise ownership requirement and replaces it with the aggregate-before-localization interface already dictated by the accepted Stokes and height-limit architecture. It also exposes and sharply simplifies the remaining artificial-residue seam without promoting an unvalidated compact bound.
